17.say: Check that. Fermentation only keeps glycolysis going. How many ATP per glucose does the cell get?
hit: fermentation gives the cell about 32 atp
miss: When oxygen is missing, fermentation turns NADH back into NAD+. That gives NAD+ back to glycolysis so it can keep making 2 ATP per glucose.
fermentation makes 2 atp, but with oxygen the cell makes 36
fermentation lets glycolysis make 4 atp total and 2 net

19.say: Check that. Count again. Pyruvic acid has 3 carbons. How many does ethyl alcohol have?
hit: ethyl alcohol has more carbons than pyruvic acid
pyruvic acid has fewer carbons than alcohol
miss: Pyruvic acid has 3 carbons, but ethyl alcohol has only 2. One carbon leaves as carbon dioxide gas and floats away.
ethyl alcohol has fewer carbons than pyruvic acid
pyruvic acid has more carbons than alcohol

22.say: Check that. Fermentation lasts about 90 seconds. What powers exercise longer than that?
hit: long exercise is powered by lactic acid fermentation
miss: Stored ATP lasts only a few seconds. Lactic acid fermentation supplies ATP for about 90 seconds, like a sprint. Cellular respiration powers longer exercise.
a sprint is powered by lactic acid fermentation, long exercise by cellular respiration
fermentation powers short bursts, not long exercise
